messages:
Ava (People Ops): @channel Quick note: Global Wellness Week is next Mon-Fri. Two things for Monday: onsite flu & TDap clinic 09:00-15:00 in Lobby A, and optional "No-Meet Monday" deep-focus hours 09:00-12:00. Sign ups for shots here: https://tinyurl.com/rw-wellness-clinic

Ben (Facilities): We'll run extra HVAC filters that day and set up two quiet rooms on Floor 4 (rooms Q1/Q2). If you need a private nursing/pumping room, DM me and we'll reserve one.

Claire (Health): Clinic details: walk-ins welcome but vaccine supply preferred for registered folks. Shots available: Influenza (standard), TDap, and flu booster for eligible folks. Please bring your ID and insurance card if you want us to bill. No-cost option available for those on Redwood plan.

Dmitri: If I take the vaccine, any side effects I should plan for? I have a client call at 10:30.

Claire (Health): Common side effects: mild arm soreness, low-grade fever in <24hrs. If you have a critical call, book a later slot or WFH that afternoon. We recommend avoiding heavy exercise for 24hrs.

Ellen: For people commuting downtown, are there any schedule changes? I take the 08:00 express shuttle.

Ava (People Ops): Shuttle schedule stays the same but we added a 16:30 PM express for folks who want to leave earlier for rest/recovery. Mark "early-exit" in the clinic form to request a guaranteed seat.

Ben (Facilities): Catering note: healthy boxed lunches available 11:30-13:30 for clinic participants and Wellness Week registrants. Vegan/GF/low-sugar options included. Add dietary notes on the sign-up form.

health-bot: health-bot reminder: Please wait 15 minutes in the observation area after receiving a vaccine if it's your first dose or you have a history of reactions.

Ava (People Ops): Also: we're piloting a "mental health half-day" policy during Wellness Week. Managers can approve a 4-hour paid block for employees to use therapy/appointments/self-care. Put requests in the time-off tool and tag "wellness-week". HR will fast-track approvals.

Dmitri: Is childcare coverage available? My sitter is booked for daytime.

Ava (People Ops): We have a limited flex-care stipend of $100 for the week for parents/caregivers who need short-term backup. Apply via expenses with tag "wellness-care" and attach receipt. Priority to caretakers attending onsite programming.

Claire (Health): Masking: clinic staff will wear masks. Masking in the lobby is optional but encouraged for anyone feeling unwell. If you want a KN95, pick one up at the welcome table.

Ellen: calendar-bot can you add a 15-min clinic reminder to my calendar when I sign up?

calendar-bot: calendar-bot: Add-on: if you submit sign-up, reply here with "add-reminder" and I'll create a 15-min pre reminder on your work calendar.

Ava (People Ops): TL;DR: Sign up for shots (link), quiet rooms reserved, extra shuttle 16:30, boxed lunches provided, mental-health half-day pilot and $100 flex-care stipend. Final signup closes Fri noon. Questions or accessibility needs DM me. Thanks! :seedling:
